patterns.note: The hero section consistently uses a split layout with a large, left-aligned text block and a prominent image occupying the right two-thirds of the screen.
A sophisticated contrast is established between oversized, elegant serif headings (e.g., 'LUXURY', 'Upcoming auctions') and clean, legible sans-serif for body text, navigation, and smaller labels.

The site primarily uses a high-contrast palette of black and white, accented by a warm off-white/beige for background variations and allowing the vibrant product imagery to provide the main color interest.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, and the hero section features an auto-rotating image carousel.
Content sections below the hero are organized into distinct grid layouts (e.g., 3-column for auction listings, 2-column for articles) with clear headings and consistent card-like structures.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed header that remains at the top of the viewport on scroll, providing persistent navigation. The hero section utilizes an auto-playing image carousel to showcase different featured items, transitioning between images without user interaction. Beyond the hero, content sections appear statically as the user scrolls, without any scroll-triggered fade-ins, slide-ins, or parallax effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (e.g., 'LUXURY' is ~4-5x body text) are paired with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels and standard, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (elements, images, and buttons primarily use 0px border-radius, maintaining a crisp, formal aesthetic).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more balanced density within content grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a very large, elegant serif font for key headings, paired with a clean sans-serif, creates a sophisticated, editorial feel. The high-contrast color palette and minimal use of decorative elements allow the high-value auction items to be the undisputed visual focus, conveying luxury and authority without being ostentatious.
